findings.current: The radiance of Aura, the power gifted to humanity by the gods, spread in every direction, then turned toward one being.
findings.defect: Changes the singular 신 to multiple gods.
findings.rationale: The source names one divine giver, not several.
findings.replacement: The radiance of Aura, the power God had gifted to humanity, spread in every direction, then turned toward one being.
findings.source: 인류가 신으로부터 선물 받은 힘. 오라(Aura)의 광휘가 온 사방을 물들였고, 이내 한 존재를 향해 겨누어졌다.

findings.current: Everyone here had been chosen by the gods to face monsters, and given the name Hunter by humanity.
findings.defect: Again pluralizes 신 and drops the exclusivity of the purpose for which the Hunters were chosen.
findings.rationale: 신 is singular, and 오직 makes fighting monsters their sole appointed purpose.
findings.replacement: Everyone here had been chosen by God for the sole purpose of fighting monsters, and given the name Hunter by humanity.
findings.source: 이 자리의 모두는 오직 몬스터와 대적하기 위해 신에게 선택받고, 인류로부터 사냥꾼(Hunter)이라는 이름을 부여받은 이들.

findings.defect: Leaves the contrast’s predicate unclear: Michael thinks his own position is safe, but Jin is not.
findings.rationale: 놈은 아니다 contrasts Jin’s prospects with Michael’s preceding 괜찮다, not Jin with the throne.
findings.replacement: But Jin Taekyung wouldn’t be fine. Not him.
findings.source:
하지만, 하지만 괜찮다.

왕좌(王佐)는 아직 고스란히 남아 있으니까.

이제 개표가 시작되면, 자신이 앉는 그곳이 바로 왕좌가 될 테니까.

그러나 진태경은, 놈은 아니다.

findings.current:
“If you hadn’t colluded with a monster, but… were already no different from one…”

Michael Silbert swallowed as Jin’s words trailed off. Then a quiet remark shook his world.

“What would happen then?”
findings.defect: Moves the revelation that Michael is already like a monster before his reaction, changing what the intervening pause conceals.
findings.rationale: The source withholds 이미 몬스터나 다름없다면 until after Michael swallows.
findings.replacement:
“What if you hadn’t colluded with a monster, but…”

Michael Silbert swallowed as Jin’s words trailed off. Then a quiet remark shook his world.

“You were already no different from one? What would happen then?”
findings.source:
“만약 몬스터와 결탁한 것이 아니라…….”

흐려지는 말꼬리에 미카엘 실베르트가 숨을 삼킨 그 순간. 나직한 한 마디가 그의 세상을 뒤흔들었다.

“이미 몬스터나 다름없다면, 그럼 어떻게 되는 거지?”

findings.current: Along with the contemptuous gazes directed at something that was neither human nor monster, Jin’s final words brought everything to a close.
findings.defect: Turns a singular contemptuous gaze into plural gazes, suggesting the crowd already shares it.
findings.rationale: 눈빛 is singular; the source does not attribute contempt to multiple onlookers.
findings.replacement: With a contemptuous gaze fixed on something neither human nor monster, Jin delivered one final line.
findings.source: 인간도, 몬스터도 아닌 무언가를 향한 경멸의 눈빛. 그리고 종지부를 찍는 마지막 한 마디와 함께.

summary: Several meaningful shifts in the draft affect the scene’s logic, attribution, and final reveal.
